name: Family-Based Residence (Spouse of a Jordanian)

qualifying_event.description: A foreign national married to a Jordanian citizen may apply for family-based residence with the Public Security Directorate.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; spouse's Jordanian national ID.

requirements.blocker_text: Marriage to a Jordanian citizen, evidenced by a marriage document.
Medical clearance is required (specifically noted for foreign wives in the source service listing).

sources.title: Jordan Public Security Directorate (PSD), Borders and Residence Department -- Information Services: Family-Based Residence for a foreign spouse of a Jordanian, 30 JOD annual fee, requiring marriage document, spouse's national ID, and medical clearance (specified for wives)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jordan). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to PSD's own service listing (tier-1) but thin: the listing is worded around a foreign wife of a Jordanian husband specifically (medical clearance is noted 'for wives'), consistent with Jordan's broader asymmetric nationality-law framework (see jo_citizenship_by_marriage.json) -- whether and how a foreign husband of a Jordanian wife accesses an equivalent residence category was not confirmed in this pass and is not assumed to be identical. This file models only the spousal category; PSD's listing does not detail residence categories for other family members (parents, children) of a foreign resident, which were not found and are not modeled here. work_rights is set 'restricted' as a conservative default -- the source did not state whether this residence category carries open work rights, and 'restricted' was chosen over 'full' to avoid overclaiming. leads_to_citizenship path applies only to wives per jo_citizenship_by_marriage.json's asymmetric rule.
